prompts.shoulders:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: production PNG animation sprite atlas for the existing children's movement-memory game Ritim Canavarı. The attached PNG is the EXACT edit target character: keep his same detailed brown hairstyle, large glossy eyes, face, blue hoodie with white cuffs, white T-shirt with yellow star, red shorts, white blue-striped socks, blue/white star sneakers, bold dark outline, rich polished 2D cartoon drawing. DO NOT redesign or simplify him. Change only arm poses.
Create ONE transparent sprite sheet, 3072x2048, exactly THREE EQUAL COLUMNS and TWO EQUAL ROWS, one full-body figure per square cell, no labels, text, arrows, motion lines, backdrop or extra figures. All heads same size, all shoes at 94% cell height, body centered at 50% width, enough padding to contain every hand. Identical frontal camera, fully visible hands and shoes. The child's ANATOMICAL RIGHT is on the VIEWER'S LEFT. The child's ANATOMICAL LEFT is on the VIEWER'S RIGHT. Make direction anatomically exact.
COLUMN 1 = RIGHT HAND TO LEFT SHOULDER:
top cell preparation: his RIGHT arm (viewer-left upper arm) begins moving diagonally across chest, right hand midway up chest, LEFT arm relaxed DOWN alongside viewer-right thigh.
bottom cell target: his RIGHT hand travels across and palm firmly rests on his LEFT shoulder (viewer-right blue shoulder), fingers visibly touching blue fabric. RIGHT elbow comes from viewer-left. LEFT hand is relaxed and clearly visible alongside viewer-right thigh. Not two hands and not own-side shoulder.
COLUMN 2 = LEFT HAND TO RIGHT SHOULDER:
top preparation: LEFT arm (viewer-right upper arm) diagonally across chest, hand halfway up; RIGHT arm down alongside viewer-left thigh.
bottom target: LEFT hand firmly rests on RIGHT shoulder (viewer-left blue shoulder), LEFT elbow comes from viewer-right. RIGHT hand relaxed clearly visible at viewer-left thigh.
COLUMN 3 = BOTH HANDS CROSS TO OPPOSITE SHOULDERS:
top preparation: both forearms coming across chest, palms moving toward opposite shoulders, arms not yet touching targets.
bottom target: a clear X of forearms over the white star shirt, his RIGHT palm at viewer-right LEFT shoulder, his LEFT palm at viewer-left RIGHT shoulder. Exactly two arms, two hands, no additional hands, each wrist connected to its correct elbow. Both shoulder contacts explicit.
This is an educational gesture demonstration. Accurate visible hand-to-shoulder contact and readability at distance matter more than decorative effects. Preserve original character proportions and drawing quality. True alpha transparency, no checkerboard.
prompts.headHips:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the exact attached boy into a clean 3-column x 2-row transparent PNG sprite atlas for a children's gesture game. Keep the SAME face, brown spiky hairstyle, huge glossy eyes, blue open hoodie and white cuffs, yellow star on white shirt, red shorts, white/blue striped socks, blue-white star sneakers, exact proportions, bold contours and detailed polished 2D shading. Change only arm poses. One full body per cell, equal square cells, 3072x2048 total. NO background, NO gradients, NO cast shadows, NO glow, NO arrows, NO sparkles, NO text. Genuinely clear alpha between figures. No figure may touch a cell edge. 8% top padding, feet at 94% height; keep each body same size and center. Front view. Anatomical right=VIEWER LEFT; anatomical left=VIEWER RIGHT.
Column 1, top: preparation for LEFT HAND ON HEAD, RIGHT HAND ON HIP. The viewer-right LEFT arm is lifting toward its own temple, palm near cheek but not on head yet; viewer-left RIGHT palm already rests on the OUTER RIGHT WAIST SIDE, at the seam ABOVE the red shorts, elbow sticks outward. Not a hand on the belly. Bottom: target, viewer-right LEFT palm clearly contacts the TOP/SIDE of the head above the ear, viewer-left RIGHT palm on the OUTER side waist. Both contacts visible and unambiguous.
Column 2, top: exact opposite preparation, viewer-left RIGHT hand lifting toward its own temple and viewer-right LEFT hand on OUTER LEFT WAIST, elbow outward. Bottom: target RIGHT palm on head at viewer-left, LEFT palm on outer waist at viewer-right. Do not swap arms or put a hand on stomach.
Column 3, top: preparation for BOTH HANDS ON HIPS, both elbows opening outward, palms approaching side waist. Bottom: target BOTH palms contacting the OUTER WAIST SIDES at the hoodie hem/shorts waistband, clear space between elbows and torso. Arms form two triangles, fingers sit on SIDE WAIST, not in front of belly, not crossed.
Exactly two hands and two arms per figure. Clothing, face, all facial proportions stay faithful. These must instruct a child at 3 metres to perform the exact contacts.
prompts.knees:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production gesture-animation PNG for Ritim Canavarı. Use the EXACT boy in the attached transparent reference, same detailed face, brown hairstyle, large glossy eyes, blue hoodie white cuffs, white shirt with yellow star, red shorts, blue striped white socks, blue-white star sneakers, thick clear outlines and polished 2D shading. ONLY change posture/arms. Make a TRANSPARENT THREE COLUMN x TWO ROW equal-cell atlas, 3072x2048, six full-body drawings. No text, numbers, arrows, effects, background, haze, gradient, shadows, extra people. 8% padding all sides. Equal scale/head size in every cell. Feet grounded at 94% of cell height, same shoe spacing. Never enlarge a bending pose to fill the cell; bending must LOWER the head. Preserve correct connected shoulder→elbow→wrist→hand anatomy, exactly two hands per child.
Front-facing child: anatomical RIGHT hand starts at VIEWER LEFT shoulder; anatomical LEFT hand starts at VIEWER RIGHT shoulder. RIGHT knee is viewer-left, LEFT knee is viewer-right.
COLUMN 1, BOTH HANDS ON OWN KNEES:
TOP preparation: gently bend knees and torso, right hand reaches downward toward viewer-left right knee, left hand toward viewer-right left knee, both palms still several centimetres ABOVE knees.
BOTTOM target: torso bends forward and knees bend, his RIGHT palm clearly rests ON viewer-left RIGHT KNEECAP, LEFT palm ON viewer-right LEFT KNEECAP. Hands distinct peach skin over bare knee skin outlined clearly, not hips, not shorts. The face looks toward us, does not obscure wrists or knees.
COLUMN 2, RIGHT HAND TOUCHES OPPOSITE LEFT KNEE:
TOP preparation: torso bends, RIGHT arm from viewer-left shoulder reaches diagonally downward across body, palm halfway to viewer-right LEFT knee. Inactive LEFT hand stays HIGHER at viewer-right outer waist, plainly separate from knees.
BOTTOM target: RIGHT palm (arm rooted in viewer-left shoulder) firmly touches viewer-right LEFT KNEECAP, with a single readable diagonal right forearm across the white shirt/red shorts. Inactive LEFT hand remains at viewer-right outer waist above shorts, elbow outward. No left hand near the other knee. It must be unmistakably ONE hand at ONE opposite knee.
COLUMN 3, LEFT HAND TOUCHES OPPOSITE RIGHT KNEE:
TOP preparation: LEFT arm from viewer-right shoulder diagonally down across body, palm midway to viewer-left RIGHT knee. Inactive RIGHT hand stays HIGHER at viewer-left outer waist.
BOTTOM target: LEFT palm (arm rooted in viewer-right shoulder) firmly touches viewer-left RIGHT KNEECAP. Inactive RIGHT hand remains at viewer-left outer waist above shorts. Never place both hands on knees in columns 2 or 3.
The hands and all fingers must be visible, elbows naturally bend, zero duplicated hands. Clear child-friendly instruction pose at 3 metres. GENUINE ALPHA transparency, no dark or coloured backdrop.
